Parent likely creating new object/function refs each render. React sees new reference = new prop = re-render, even if value unchanged. Common culprits: **Inline objects/arrays in props:** ```jsx // new object every render ``` Fix: move outside or `useMemo`: ```jsx const style = { color: 'red' }; // or const style = useMemo(() => ({ color: 'red' }), []); ``` **Inline callbacks:** ```jsx handleClick(id)} /> // new function every render ``` Fix: `useCallback`: ```jsx const handleClick = useCallback(() => doSomething(id), [id]); ``` **Parent re-renders from unrelated state:** Parent state change triggers re-render, passes new prop refs to child, child re-renders even if actual values same. Verify: log props in child. If same values logged but re-render happens, it's ref issue. Wrap child in `memo()` to skip re-render when props shallow-equal: ```jsx const Child = memo(({ prop }) =>
{prop}
); ``` Which pattern matches what you're seeing?
